items.title: A map of modules whose induced map on first Tor vanishes for all test modules factors through a free module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises, by the vanishing for every test module of the map induced on first Tor, those maps out of a finitely presented module that factor through a free module (author lemma at source lines 4298-4304, label lemma-map-tor-1-zero). The proof (source lines 4306-4337) builds a map of short exact sequences from a presentation of the source module and a free presentation of the target, forms the pushout along the map of kernels, and then does a diagram chase to identify the connecting map of the pushout sequence with the assumed-vanishing boundary map; universal exactness and the cross-chapter splitting criterion then give the factorisation (proof lines 4329-4336). The pushout construction with its diagram chase is the content, and the finite presentation hypothesis enters exactly at the splitting step. H2.
